text:
alex.h: @oncall-bot PagerDuty alert: pg-primary high active connections + app 5xx spike. Monitoring shows connection queueing and increased p99 query times. Paging now.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident: INCIDENT-6234 triggered (pg-primary high-connections). Notified: eng-oncall, db-team.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page delivered to alex.h (ack required).

alex.h: Acked. I'm looking — checking pgbouncer stats and app connection counts.

priya.m: Seeing huge surge of short-lived clients from the worker pool; some retries hitting Redis too — Redis maxclients warning firing in parallel. Could be retry storm from failed DB ops.

samir: I have the PG query queue open. Many identical SELECTs from /api/recents w/ long planner time. Might be a missing index or locking.

leah: Customer reports latency on feed endpoints. Statuspage draft: "Degraded performance for feed API — engineering investigating." I can post once we have mitigations.

emma: Can we open read-replica to absorb read traffic? I'm standing by to scale replicas and add a temporary route to reads.

alex.h: Yes, do that. Also increase pgbouncer pool to avoid queueing. On standby to throttle incoming traffic if needed.

infra-runner: Scaling read-replicas +1 (aws rds-replica-04) — kicking off now. ETA ~3m.

priya.m: Running a quick grep — the worker library recently rolled an HTTP client retry change last deploy. If all retries are aggressive, that amplifies DB pressure. I'm going to flip the retry to exponential backoff on the worker config for the feed job.

samir: While replica comes up, bumping pgbouncer max_client_conn and default_pool_size. Command I'm running on bastion: ```bash
sudo sed -i 's/default_pool_size = 20/default_pool_size = 60/' /etc/pgbouncer/pgbouncer.ini
sudo systemctl restart pgbouncer
```

alex.h: Good. Note: restarting will briefly drop new connections — do it quickly. Monitor queue_depth metric.

infra-runner: Replica up. Redirecting read traffic: updating HAProxy weights to send 40% reads to replica. Command: ```bash
haproxyctl set backend feed_backend weight read-replica-04 40
```

leah: Posted to status page: "Investigating — some customers may experience elevated latency on feed endpoints."

priya.m: I disabled immediate retry in worker config (set retries=1, backoff=linear->expo). Pushed change to canary workers. Observing less bursty traffic now.

samir: pgbouncer restart completed. default_pool_size=60 applied. Queue depth dropped from ~320 to ~30. p99 query time falling from 1.8s -> 400ms.

alex.h: Redis maxclients alert still firing but trending down. Looks like a downstream retry pile was opening many ephemeral clients. priyam, can you also gate the workers to use a redis client pool?

priya.m: On it — switching workers to pooled Redis client. Will roll to 10% canary first.

emma: Any customer-facing rollback needed? We could disable the new retry changes fully if things aren't stable.

leah: No rollback yet; customers are asking for ETA. Suggest "partial mitigation in progress, monitoring metrics" with 15m cadence updates.

oncall-bot: Auto-escalation check: If not acknowledged by senior db within 10m, escalate.

alex.h: Going to pull DB slow query list and look for hot plan. If there's a plan regression we may need to revert the DB migration from last week.

samir: Found a missing index on feed_items(user_id, created_at) — heavy seq scan for many requests. The migration rolled but index build failed partially during maintenance window. Suggest creating index concurrently.

alex.h: Create index concurrently. Command: ```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_feed_user_created_at ON feed_items (user_id, created_at DESC);
```
But this will take minutes; schedule on low write.

priya.m: Starting the concurrent index create now. Monitoring replication lag.

infra-runner: Replication lag nominal. Index creation started (pid 32567).

samir: If index creation holds, we might avoid rollback. Also recommend temporary rate-limit on feed endpoints to reduce pressure: add 20% global throttling.

alex.h: Pushed a temporary rate-limit rule to API gateway: ```json
{"route":"/api/feeds","limit":"80%","duration":"1m"}```
This should reduce new inflight queries.

leah: Updated statuspage: "Partial mitigation: read replica added, throttle applied, engineering is creating index. Next update in 15 minutes."

priya.m: Redis pooled rollout at 10% looks good — connections per worker down by 70% on canary. Rolling to 50%.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation check — senior DB oncall pinged (samir) — acknowledged.

samir: Index build completed. Verified index usage on the slow query. p99 now ~120ms.

alex.h: Great work. I'm going to un-throttle to 95% and reduce pgbouncer pool back to 40 gradually.

infra-runner: HAProxy weights reverted; reads flow normalized. Rolling pgbouncer default_pool_size -> 40.

priya.m: Redis pooled rollout complete. Maxclients alerts cleared.

leah: Final statuspage update: "Resolved — index created and routing changes mitigated load. Some customers may have experienced elevated latency for ~18 minutes. Follow-up postmortem scheduled."

alex.h: Closing PagerDuty incident. Will file a short postmortem with timeline and action items: 1) fix retry config in worker release pipeline 2) ensure index builds validated post-migrations 3) add circuit-breaker in gateway for feed route 4) add Redis client pooling requirements in worker library.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INCIDENT-6234 closed by alex.h.

leah: Thanks team. I'll create the postmortem doc and link it here. :thumbsup:
